# Promoted to repo memory: r1-fixes

Cite these in .sofar/repo.md by qualified handle — `r1-fixes M<n>` —
which is how `sofar doctor` sees that a promoted fact reached repo memory.

- **M1** (2026-09-15T15:47:40.291Z) — A fresh git worktree of this repo has no node_modules and no packages/engine/dist (gitignored). Run `npm ci` then `npm run build` before `npm test`. Otherwise `npx vitest` fetches a mismatched vitest and fails to load vitest.config.ts, and spawn-based suites fail because they execute dist/cli.js.
- **M2** (2026-09-16T06:19:32.713Z) — Ending clean (record-hygiene D1 in practice): the PostToolUse exemption applies only when EVERY shell segment leads with git or sofar. A commit whose message comes from a heredoc (`git commit -F - <<'EOF'`), or a git chain with a trailing `| head`/`| grep`, is NOT exempt — it lands a command_run AFTER the write-back and the tree is dirty again. Write the message to a scratch file first, then `git add <paths> && git commit -F <file>` with no pipes; verify with a separate `git status --short`.
